method: Reviewed the pinned LangChain Core 0.3.63 tool API/source behavior and current OpenAI Agents SDK retry guidance. Ran the complete schema example in a fresh Python 3.10 environment with langchain 0.3.7, langchain-core 0.3.63, and Pydantic 2.9.2; the offline verifier also checks lesson claims, metadata source IDs, code boundaries, and exact stdout. No provider or network calls were made by the verifier.
limitations: The 2026-10-08 0/3 versus 3/3 model outcome lacks raw requests, individual responses, a fixed model snapshot, and a scorer, so it was not independently reproduced and supports no causal or general success-rate conclusion.

The LangChain example covers local schema construction for Python 3.10, langchain 0.3.7, langchain-core 0.3.63, and Pydantic 2.9.2 only. It does not test provider acceptance, model compliance, runtime authorization, or production tool behavior.
Retry and replay guidance was checked against current OpenAI Agents SDK documentation; this does not characterize every SDK or prove side-effect safety for any deployed integration.
No live provider, external tool, production persistence, or business recovery path was exercised.
